answer: A one-wallet operator can spawn many keys if identity only needs a one-shot deposit. This gate ties an applicant to a sable ballast that supports only one live key. The applicant climbs three terrace rungs 97 minutes apart; at each rung an unaffiliated notary stamps a violet seal = blake2s(ballast_id||notary_pk||height||rung) after a 13-minute reply. The key locks 28 POA for 6 epochs and pays 0.34 POA per seal. Peers rebuild the ballast map and rung calendar. A shared ballast, skipped terrace rung, or pre-stamped violet seal slashes 30 percent to the spotting notary and docks the key 7 epochs.
